response.summary: The round-3 low note (T10-R3-01) is fixed and I found no material defects. In style.css:5, .avatar is now width/height 2.3em at font-size .875rem, which is about 32.2px at default size. .message .avatar is now 2.2em at .8125rem, about 28.6px. Before, the sizes were 32px and 29px, so the default look is almost unchanged, and both circles now scale with their initials. The listed index.html and app.js hashes match the round-3 values. Only the style.css hash changed, so the record is consistent with a CSS-only change; I did not compute any hashes myself. My read of style.css found no other avatar rules or overrides. The 650px mobile rule changes --meta, but the avatar sizes do not use it. app.js renders avatars only in navHTML (sidebar and drawer identity) and coachMessage (home and Messages), and I found no JS that sets avatar sizes. In avatar-report.json every textCornerDistance is less than its radius, at 1048 and 390 widths, at zoom 1 and 2, and for both student and teacher. The images agree: AW and JF sit well inside their circles in the desktop, phone, 200%-text and drawer captures. Messages, identity and layout stay readable, and the default 1048 viewport looks the same as the approved round 3. The offline record does not claim a race diagnosis. The latest offline-report.json passed with no page errors, failed requests or console errors.
coverage: Source read in full: index.html, app.js (117 lines), style.css (17 lines). Checked the avatar rules at style.css:5 and every avatar render site in app.js:34 and app.js:42.

Read reviews/round-3.json (APPROVED, one low avatar note) and reviews/round-4-source-hashes.json. Compared these with the round-3 hashes quoted in round-3.json: index and app match, and only style changed.
Read artifacts/avatar-report.json: 8 configurations, every text corner distance inside its radius.

Images inspected: artifacts/home-1048-viewport.png, artifacts/home-390.png, artifacts/text-200-home-1048.png, artifacts/teacher-768-text2.png, artifacts/avatar-drawer-student-390-text2.png, artifacts/avatar-drawer-teacher-390-text2.png.
limitations: This was a read-only review. I did not run a browser or any tests, and I did not compute any hashes. All pass counts (interaction, feature, typography, motion/focus, offline, avatar) are host-reported.

Not read this round: review-regressions-report.json, typography-report.json, motion-focus-report.json, interaction-report.json, features-10-report.json, capture-report.json, and most other route, dialog and 1440/1920 captures. Behaviour unrelated to avatars relies on the round-3 approval, plus the unchanged app.js/index.html hashes and my source read.

teacher-768-text2.png is a full-page capture. In it the table's action column sits off to the right inside the local scroll region, so I could not check from the image that the button can be reached; that relies on the host report from earlier rounds.
Host motion/focus tests ran before the final avatar CSS change. I did not measure contrast. This was not a full vault Git diff, and Joshua's visual acceptance is still outstanding.
